components.name: Primary Button

components.html: <button class="ds-btn-primary"><svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.75" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round"><path d="M5 12.5l4.5 4.5L19 7.5"/></svg>Сохранить</button>

components.css: .ds-layout-card { width: 138px; padding: 16px; border-radius: 18px; background: #fff; border: 1px solid #e8ecf4; box-shadow: 0 6px 22px #22325a1a; font-family: 'Segoe UI', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 180ms; } .ds-layout-card:hover { border-color: #b9d9fb; } .ds-layout-card b { display: block; margin-top: 12px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600; color: #1d2433; } .ds-layout-card small { display: block; margin-top: 4px; font-size: 12px; color: #687287; } .ds-mini { display: grid; grid-template-areas: 'a b b' 'a c d'; grid-template-columns: 2fr 1fr 1fr; gap: 4px; height: 92px; padding: 6px; box-sizing: border-box; border-radius: 10px; background: #f4f6fb; } .ds-mini i { border-radius: 5px; background: #a9d5ff; transition: all 260ms cubic-bezier(0.65, 0, 0.35, 1); } .ds-mini i:nth-child(1) { background: #008cff; } .ds-mini i:nth-child(2) { background: #5cb3ff; } .ds-layout-card.is-on { background: #0070e0; border-color: transparent; box-shadow: 0 10px 24px #0070e04d; } .ds-layout-card.is-on b { color: #fff; } .ds-layout-card.is-on small { color: #dcecff; } .ds-layout-card.is-on .ds-mini { background: #ffffff26; } .ds-layout-card.is-on .ds-mini i { background: #ffffffa6; } .ds-layout-card.is-on .ds-mini i:nth-child(1) { background: #ffffff; } .ds-layout-card.is-on .ds-mini i:nth-child(2) { background: #ffffffd9; } .ds-layout-card:focus-visible { outline: none; box-shadow: inset 0 0 0 2px #9ccdff, 0 10px 24px #0070e04d; }

narrative.overview:
The launcher is a light, soft settings dashboard: a lavender-grey canvas holding white, generously rounded cards that float on low, diffuse shadows. A white icon-and-label sidebar anchors the left; the main column carries a page title, a one-line subtitle, and the Save pill at top right. Everything a user changes is shown before it is saved, and the system's one expressive device is the live layout miniature, a four-tile diagram that follows the chosen layout, gap and master count, used as the logo mark, the layout picker and the welcome badge.

Density is calm, not sparse: 13px body in Segoe UI, 44 to 54px setting rows, 18px card padding. One blue does all the signalling; neutrals are cool and slightly violet so white cards read as raised without borders doing the work. The world was pinned by the user's own reference (a soft file-manager dashboard) and deliberately refuses the dense dark form-list the launcher used to be. Light theme only for now.
keyCharacteristics: Lavender-grey canvas, white 18px cards, soft offset shadows.
One blue accent family; filled controls use the stronger blue.
Pill buttons, rounded-square icon badges, outline icons on a 24px grid.
The live layout miniature as the signature and brand mark.
Russian UI text in Segoe UI; nothing smaller than 12px.

rules.name: The One Blue Rule
rules.body: Blue is the only hue that means "chosen", "act" or "data". No second accent; status colours appear only as soft-wash plus ink pairs and only for real status.

rules.name: The Filled-Means-Strong Rule
rules.body: A blue surface that carries white text uses accent-strong, never accent; accent is for strokes, dots, arcs and tints.

rules.name: The 12px Floor Rule
rules.body: No text below 12px anywhere in the launcher.

rules.name: The Two-Line Setting Rule
rules.body: Every setting is a 13px ink label with an optional 12px muted hint beneath it; the control sits right-aligned on the same row.

rules.name: The Soft Lift Rule
rules.body: Every shadow is blurred at least twice its offset and tinted with the cool ink, never pure black. Depth reads as light, not as outline.

dos: Do put every setting in a white 18px card on the lavender canvas, with a 16px/600 section label sitting on the canvas above it.
Do use Deep Press Blue for anything filled and white-labelled, Signal Blue for strokes, dots and arcs, Ice Wash for selection.
Do pair every label with a plain-language 12px muted hint when the effect is not obvious.
Do reuse the live layout miniature wherever a layout is shown; never substitute a static picture.
Do gate every animation on the motion setting (AppTheme.motion); 140ms for state colour, 160 to 260ms for movement.
Do draw new icons as 24px outline SVGs, 1.75 stroke, round caps and joins, tinted at runtime.
donts: Don't introduce a second accent hue or use status colours for decoration.
Don't use black or hard-edged shadows on cards; keep the soft, cool, blurred lift.
Don't use square buttons; actions are pills.
Don't show a status, count or ring the launcher cannot actually read.
Don't build a dense dark form-list; this world is light, soft and carded.
